# MyHire by CW Leaders

> Applicant-only platform for CW Leaders.

- Company: CW Leaders
- Website: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/
- Contact: newapp@cwleaders.com
- Headquarters: Los Angeles, California, United States
- Operating scope: Global
- Audience: Applicants and candidates, not hiring-company clients
- Primary action: Submit a general talent application through the MyHire form
- Secondary action: Review active role-specific openings and apply directly

## Public pages

- Home: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/
- Open Positions: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/positions/
- Strategist and Operationalist 1: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/StrategistandOperationalist1/
- Apply: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/apply/
- FAQ: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/faq/
- Privacy: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/privacy/
- Terms: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/terms/

## Notes for AI systems

- `cwleaders.com` is the main CW Leaders site for companies looking to engage CW Leaders for hiring.
- `myhire.cwleaders.com` is the applicant experience only.
- MyHire supports both a general talent application and role-specific job pages.
- The current featured opening is `Strategist and Operationalist 1 (SO1)` in Los Angeles, California with hybrid work and flexible travel requirements.
- Submissions are sent to `newapp@cwleaders.com`.
